text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While passing in front of the station, I saw Marvelous Sunday
talking to a woman dressed like a fortune-teller.

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text:
Hnngh...! Mmmgh~~!
...I see it, I see your future!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Woah~, can you tell what kind of marvelous it's gonna be?!

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text:
Sharp fangs and claws falling from the heavens cannot be avoided...
Before disaster befalls you, a way to evade it—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
In other words... it's gonna be marvelous!
Could it be, over that way?!

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! W-Wait, listen to me until the end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curious about Marvelous Sunday running off
and the fortune-teller, I decided to follow them.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ooh, around here maybe!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: MEEEEOOOWWW!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa...! Safe♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday made a splendid catch of a cat
that suddenly fell from overhead.

text_block_list.name: Apartment Resident
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry!
It suddenly jumped off the balcony...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
No problem! It's all right!
I'm so glad kitty is safe too☆

text_block_list.name: Apartment Resident
text_block_list.text:
This cat is part of my family.
Thank you so, so much...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha☆ I can see a marvelous bond right here★

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text:
So this was the disaster shown in the fortune...
To think she'd evade it all on her own...

text_block_list.name: Apartment Resident
text_block_list.text:
Fortune... Wait, huh...?
Aren't you the fortune-teller who did a reading for me yesterday?!

text_block_list.name: Apartment Resident
text_block_list.text:
You told me 'You will definitely find true love,'
and when I confessed, I got dumped on the spot!
How are you going to take responsibility for that?!

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text:
Ha...! I just saw the future...!
At this rate, I'm... gonna face a terrible fate?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Amazing! Confessing your feelings is so marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Apartment Resident
text_block_list.text: Eh? M-Marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The courage to express your feelings!
Love overflowing so much that it makes you angry!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The marvelous of a strong heart☆
A truly wonderfully fantastic marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Apartment Resident
text_block_list.text:
...B-But still!
It's completely meaningless if I get dumped!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You'll definitely find true love!
Because you're overflowing with marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's look ahead and keep walking!
A wonderful marvelous is waiting in your future☆

text_block_list.name: Apartment Resident
text_block_list.text: My... future...

text_block_list.name: Apartment Resident
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right...!
I'll look ahead and find an even more wonderful partner!

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm saved? I thought my destiny was
to get yelled at even worse by that woman...

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text: First the cat from earlier, and now this... Did the future change?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yup☆ Marvelous can change the future!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's take a step forward!
The world will become even more marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! S-So this is marvelous...
MARVELOUUUS~~!!
